targets.title: Self-efficacy as a mediator in the relationship between self-oriented perfectionism and academic procrastination.
targets.evidence_quote: The present study aimed to conceptually replicate Seo’s (2008) study of self-oriented perfectionism, self-efficacy, and academic procrastination.
targets.outcome_quote: We were only able to partially replicate Seo’s key findings, having found no evidence of a negative relationship between self-oriented perfectionism and academic procrastination.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall partial replication verdict; indirect association supported while central bivariate association differs.
